request_text:
Updated request scope as of 5/17/24 refinement sent by Mr.Small:

We have put some thought into search restrictions and terms and here is what we would suggest:

(1) total time range of January 1, 2023 through July 31, 2023
(2) Anything that includes Juli Beth Hinds, Dr. Amy Lerner, urban studies and planning (USP), global policy & strategy (GPS), UCSD in conjunction with any of those terms
(3) Anything related to the regional water equity report or RDF
(4) Anything containing a reference to "Juli Beth Hinds, Dr Amy Lerner,  Geosyntec, USP, GPS, or the RWER or RDF", UCSD in conjunction with any of those terms sent to or from "Elise Ruiz, anyone at Murakawa Communications, anyone at Geosyntec including but not limited to Ken Susillo, Megan Otto, Stephanie Zinn; and anyone at the County including but not limited to Stephanie Gaines, Crystal Benham, Todd Snyder, Sarah Agassi, Eden Brukman, and Murtaza Baxamusa"

Original Request:

To Whom it may Concern:
I am writing on behalf of my client Juli Beth Hinds. On behalf of Ms. Hinds, please consider this a formal request pursuant to California Public Records Act, Government Code §6250 et seq. for copies of all DOCUMENTS of the County of San Diego Land Use & Environment Group that reference or relate to: Juli Beth Hinds; the Department of Urban Studies and Planning at the University of California San Diego; or Nathan Fletcher. ("DOCUMENTS" as used herein, shall be defined to mean any ''writing'' as that term is defined in Evidence Code section 250, including, but not limited to, correspondence, emails, texts, communications of any kind, recordings, tapes, computer print-outs, records, slides, photographs, notes, working papers, written analyses, memoranda, plans, telegraphs, telexes and transcriptions, electronic data, and notes or memoranda made by any telephone communications.) This request encompasses all DOCUMENTS dated or created between the dates of January 1, 2022 through the date of this letter.
I request delivery of these records to our firm's office, located at 402 W. Broadway, Suite 1270, San Diego, CA 92101, or we can arrange to pick them up at a reasonable location designated by the County.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

emails.body:
Hi Stephanie,

I hope you had a nice weekend.

I understand this is coming in late after having already discussed and submitted the proposed amendment, but I wanted to see if there might still be a possibility of adding slightly more budget for Task 6 to address the equity components/analyses. We would like to prepare some region-wide maps, setting the current condition of a few select equity metrics (e.g., affordable, safe, etc.) and then applying similar criteria to the potential enhancements. In doing the final projected staff forecasting late last week, I found we are a little short on budget to carry this forward, primarily because the original TO was framed as the “Drought Assessment” rather than the “Regional Water Equity Report,” so these equity-based analyses were not anticipated.

Let me know what you think or if you would like to discuss this over the phone.

Thanks,

Megan

Subject: Invitation: Coffee with Assemblyman Carl DeMaio

Good Afternoon,

On behalf of Assemblyman Carl DeMaio, I am pleased to invite you to an exclusive Community Coffee with Carl Meeting. As a valued leader in our community, your insights and partnership are essential as we address the key issues affecting Alpine.

This meeting is designed to bring together local officials-school board members, city council members, and other influential voices or groups-to foster collaboration on challenges we face, to share priorities, and identify solutions to better serve our constituents.

Event Details:

  *   Date: Thursday, January 23, 2025
  *   Time: 6:00pm - 7:30pm
  *   Location: Alpine Library Resource Room East - 1752 Alpine Boulevard Alpine, CA 91901
<https://lcmspubcontact.lc.ca.gov/PublicLCMS/rsvp_main.php?district=AD75&rsvp=1964>

  *   Speak Directly: Share with Assemblyman DeMaio the issues that matter most to you and your constituents.
  *   Collaborate Effectively: Explore how state and local efforts can work together to address key priorities, from education to public safety to economic development.
  *   Stronger Partnerships: Strengthen connections across political divides and work toward solutions that benefit everyone in our community.

Our office is committed to fostering collaboration in order to address the challenges our communities face. By working together, we can develop the solutions needed to deliver results for the people we serve. Your leadership and insights are critical to this effort, and we hope you'll join us in shaping the path forward for Alpine.

emails.body:
Good evening Planning Group Chairs,

Andrew Hayes here with Supervisor Anderson. I want to thank each of you for sending me your response. I wanted to let you know that the date that works for the greatest number of the chairs is Monday, April 28th at 11:00am. That is the date the Supervisor would like to go ahead with. Recognizing that all may not be able to attend in person we will be offering a virtual option as well as the option for you to send a representative in the event the Chair is unable to attend (of course if the Vice-Chair would like to attend in addition to the Chair that is more than welcome).

The in-person meeting will be located at Supervisor Anderson’s El Cajon District office at: 475 W. Bradley Ave., El Cajon, Ca 92020.

In advance of the meeting, the Supervisor has requested that you send over any of the topics you’d like discussed or would like to bring to his attention as he want’s to be sure to make this the best use of your time.

I’m looking forward to seeing you all there on Monday, April 28th, 11:00am. Lastly, in the event you are unable to attend and also not able to send a representative, I’d be happy to schedule an appointment where I can come to your planning group meeting or meet with you so you can share your thoughts and ask questions.

Thank you all and please do not hesitate to contact me anytime.
